changes.comment: Lockstep version bump for the `rawPrompt` option on `startTaskSession` (#1442, prereq for #1438).
Add `selectTaskPrompt(task, options)` — picks the first user message bytes for a task spawn, with precedence `rawPrompt` > ROOT_TASK_ID notes > `buildTaskPrompt` wrapping (#1442).

`startTaskSession` accepts a new optional `rawPrompt` argument that bypasses title/description wrapping; existing callers unchanged. Used by the heartbeat fresh-spawn fallback (#1438) and inbound channels (#1421) to match `publishToStdin` bytes (#1442).
